messages:
nina: quick follow-up after the quantization RFC. need a short rollout/playbook for FP8/INT8/4bit profiles so ops + customers know steps and guardrails.
arjun: +1. main risks: silent regressions and SLO blips. we should define a minimal telemetry bundle that every profile ships with.
sam: suggested minimal signals: 1) anchor prompt EM delta, 2) token-level perplexity delta, 3) frequent-token-change-rate, 4) latency p95. keep it tiny.
maria: can we do a tiny shadow sample (0.5%) for headwise checks? avoids perturbing latency for main path.
nina: yes shadow=0.5% is fine as default. ops constraint: total perf overhead must stay <2%.
arjun: fallback rules proposal (hysteresis): if (EM_drop >= 3% AND token_perp_delta >= 0.02) for 5m -> immediate roll to baseline profile. if only latency regressed (p95 +20%) -> try increasing batch size once, else fall back to INT8.
sam: note: batching masks some headwise errors. add per-anchor probe checks that are exempt from batching.
maria: short config snippet we can include in profile metadata to enable ops quickly:

```
quant_probe:
  probe_rate: 0.005        # 0.5% shadow by default
  anchor_prompts: ["short Q/A", "summarize long doc"]
  em_drop_threshold: 0.03
  perp_delta_threshold: 0.02
  lookback_secs: 300
  stash_kv_on_trip: true
```

nina: good. stash_kv_on_trip is important for postmortem of headwise issues. need retention policy for kv snapshots (30d).
arjun: how to version these profiles? we agreed earlier on immutable profile ids with semver style versions (p-<id>.v<major>). runtime matches on (profile_id, version). customers can pin p-123.v1.
sam: ops runbook bullets (one-liner style):
- enable profile on staging with probe_rate=0.1% for 24h
- run 48h A/B shadow against baseline with anchor EM checks
- canary 1% production with full telemetry panels
- if any two signals trip -> auto-revert + page #eng-oncall
- capture kv snapshot + logs for failing window
maria: ops-bot can automate kv snapshot if stash_kv_on_trip=true. ops-bot: can we add a runtime flag to toggle without deploy?
ops-bot: runtime-flag `quant.probe.stash_kv` added to canary agent. requires agent>=2.1.3. will auto-upload to s3 path /kv-snaps/{profile}/{ts}.
nina: ownership: sam -> runbook expansion, maria -> dashboard panels & alerts, arjun -> runtime fallback wiring, nina -> docs handoff. ship target this week?
sam: i'll draft runbook today.
maria: dashboards by EOD tomorrow.
arjun: I'll land the fallback wiring and smoke locally.
ops-bot: scheduled canary rollout (canary agent bump + probe flag) for 2025-09-12T02:00:00Z.
nina: final tiny customer-facing blurb for release notes: "Introduced compact quant profiles with built-in telemetry and safe auto-fallbacks. Customers may pin profile versions; default probe=0.5% shadow to detect headwise regressions."
sam: no objections.
maria: ack.
